# telnyx_spend_limit (Resource)

A spending cap for one product and period (daily or monthly). Set amount, or unlimited = true for explicitly no cap. When spend reaches the cap Telnyx blocks the product until the period ends. Destroy removes the limit; products with a default limit return to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Block voice once it costs more than 50 USD in a day.
resource "telnyx_spend_limit" "voice_daily" {
  product = "voice"
  period  = "daily"
  amount  = 50
  reason  = "Cap test traffic"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `period` (String) `daily` is the current UTC day; `monthly` is the current UTC calendar month. One of `daily`, `monthly`.
- `product` (String) Product the entry applies to.

### Optional

- `amount` (Number) Limit in USD. `0` blocks at the first cent of spend. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `reason` (String) Why the limit is set or changed, kept for audit. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `unlimited` (Boolean) Optional; only `false` is allowed together with `amount`. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `block` (Attributes) The active block of the period. `null` when the period is not blocked. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--block))
- `blocked` (Boolean) The product is blocked for the whole account in this period (total limit). An API key's own block appears only in `credential_limits`. Always `false` in write responses; list the limits to read the block state.
- `credential_limits` (Attributes List) List responses only. One item per API key limit of the product and period, sorted by `credential_id`, plus every API key that is still blocked. `[]` when there are none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential_limits))
- `effective_limit_usd` (String) The limit in USD that is enforced, as a decimal string. `null` means unlimited.
- `evaluation` (Attributes) What a create, update or delete did to the period at once. Only present in write responses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--evaluation))
- `limit` (Attributes) The limit set on the account for the product and period, whoever set it. `null` when none is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limit))
- `period_end` (String) Exclusive end of the current period, a UTC date.
- `period_start` (String) First UTC day of the current period.
- `product_name` (String) Display name of the product.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `spend_error` (String) Set when `spend_usd` is `null`.
- `spend_usd` (String) Spend in USD so far in the period, as a decimal string. It can lag actual usage by about a minute. `null` when it could not be read.

<a id="nestedatt--block"></a>
### Nested Schema for `block`

Read-Only:

- `blocked_until` (String) Exclusive end of the block: it is lifted at 00:00 UTC on this date at the latest.
- `detected_at` (String) When the block started.
- `limit_usd` (String) The limit in USD that the spend went above, as a decimal string.
- `spend_usd` (String) Spend in USD when the block started, as a decimal string.


<a id="nestedatt--credential_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credential_limits`

Read-Only:

- `block` (Attributes) The active block of the period. `null` when the period is not blocked. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential_limits--block))
- `blocked` (Boolean) This API key is blocked for the period.
- `credential_id` (String) Identifier of the API key as recorded on usage. Never the key's secret.
- `exceeds_total` (Boolean) The API key's limit is above the period's total limit. Only a change by Telnyx support can cause it; the total limit still applies to the whole account. Lower the API key limit or raise the total.
- `limit` (Attributes) The limit of one API key. It always has an amount. `null` for an API key that is still blocked after its limit was removed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential_limits--limit))
- `spend_error` (String) Set when `spend_usd` is `null`.
- `spend_usd` (String) Spend in USD in the period made with exactly this API key, as a decimal string. Usage without an API key identifier, or with another one, counts only toward the total. `null` when it could not be read.

<a id="nestedatt--credential_limits--block"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credential_limits.block`

Read-Only:

- `blocked_until` (String) Exclusive end of the block: it is lifted at 00:00 UTC on this date at the latest.
- `detected_at` (String) When the block started.
- `limit_usd` (String) The limit in USD that the spend went above, as a decimal string.
- `spend_usd` (String) Spend in USD when the block started, as a decimal string.


<a id="nestedatt--credential_limits--limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credential_limits.limit`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Limit in USD, as a decimal string.
- `origin` (String) `self_service` when a user of the account set it, `operator` when Telnyx support did.
- `updated_at` (String) When the limit was last set or changed.



<a id="nestedatt--evaluation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `evaluation`

Read-Only:

- `account_blocked` (Boolean) API key writes only: the account itself remains blocked for the product under a total limit. Absent for total limit writes.
- `blocked_now` (Boolean) The change blocked the product: the spend was already above the new limit.
- `evaluation_deferred` (Boolean) The spend could not be checked now. The change is saved and applied within a few minutes.
- `note` (String) Additional information about the result, when there is any.
- `released` (Boolean) The change lifted a block of this period.
- `spend_usd` (String) Spend in USD used for the check, as a decimal string. `null` when the spend was not checked.
- `still_blocked_other_period` (Boolean) The other period has an active block, so the product stays blocked whatever this period's result. For an API key write, the API key's limit in the other period.
- `still_over_limit` (Boolean) A block of this period remains because the spend is still above the new limit.


<a id="nestedatt--limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limit`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Limit in USD, as a decimal string. `null` when `unlimited` is true.
- `origin` (String) `self_service` when a user of the account set it, `operator` when Telnyx support did.
- `unlimited` (Boolean) True when the limit was set to explicitly no cap.
- `updated_at` (String) When the limit was last set or changed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_spend_limit.example <product>/<period>
```
